title: Upgrade admin system reliability, add hacker-themed admin UI, and enable order deletion

requirements.text: Fix and harden admin detection so admin-only UI appears immediately after an admin logs in (no missing/late admin button, no flicker, no incorrect Access Denied while permissions are still being determined).

quotes: Make the admin system more advanced and less glitchy so it pops up right away when a admin is logged in

acceptanceCriteria: When a user logs in as an admin, the header renders an admin affordance (e.g., Admin link/button) as soon as the admin check completes, and does not remain hidden due to stale/undefined state.
AdminGate shows a clear loading state while checking admin status and does not briefly show Access Denied for an actual admin.
If the user is authenticated and confirmed admin, navigating to / redirects them to /admin (or an equivalent immediate admin entry flow) without requiring manual refresh.
If the user is not an admin, /admin reliably shows Access Denied (and never shows admin data).

requirements.text: Ensure the backend exposes a reliable admin-check method used by the frontend (e.g., `isCallerAdmin : query () -> async Bool`) and that admin gating does not depend on missing/unstable methods.

quotes: Make the admin system more advanced and less glitchy

acceptanceCriteria: Backend provides a query method that returns whether the caller is an admin (no traps for valid authenticated callers).
Frontend `useIsAdmin` successfully calls the backend admin-check method and consistently returns `true` for admins and `false` for non-admins.
Admin-only backend methods still enforce admin permission checks server-side (admin UI cannot bypass authorization).

requirements.text: Add an admin-only order deletion workflow so admins can delete an order when a customer cancels (with a confirmation step and immediate UI refresh).

quotes: also make it so I can delete orders to if someone wants to cancel

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes an admin-only method to delete an order by orderId; deleting a non-existent order returns a clear error.
Admin Panel UI includes a per-order Delete/Cancel action with a confirmation dialog.
After deletion, the order disappears from the admin orders list without requiring a full page refresh (React Query cache invalidation/refetch works).
Non-admins cannot delete orders (frontend hides controls; backend rejects calls).

requirements.text: Replace the current 'Reset All Data' behavior with a correct, admin-only backend reset that actually deletes stored orders (and keep the frontend confirmation dialog aligned with the real behavior).

quotes: make the admin panel super cool and op and make sure the site is not buggy

acceptanceCriteria: Admin Panel 'Reset All Data' triggers a backend admin-only reset that clears persisted order data in the canister (not only localStorage).
After reset, `getAllOrders()` returns an empty list and the UI shows the 'No Orders' state.
The reset action still uses a confirmation dialog and shows pending/loading state while running.
Non-admin callers cannot invoke reset; backend enforces authorization.

requirements.text: Create a distinct, advanced 'hacker/cool' theme for admin users/routes, visually separate from the regular site theme, and apply it consistently across /admin screens and admin-only components.

quotes: also make the admins have a custom hacker cool theme make it super advanced

acceptanceCriteria: Admin routes render with a clearly distinct visual style (e.g., terminal/cyber aesthetic) while non-admin pages keep the existing site theme.
Theming is implemented without modifying immutable Shadcn component sources; styling is applied via composition, Tailwind classes, and/or CSS variables at the page/layout level.
Admin theme remains readable and accessible (sufficient contrast for primary text and controls).

requirements.text: Add additional advanced admin panel features that improve operational control without changing the user ordering flow: searching, filtering, sorting, quick actions, and lightweight order insights.

quotes: add more features you think would be good also ... plus a lot more features make the admin panel super cool and op

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can filter orders by status (pending/approved/shipped) and search by name, order ID, or ID number.
Admin can sort orders at least by creation time (newest/oldest).
Admin has one-click quick actions per order for common status transitions (e.g., Approve, Mark Shipped) with clear success/error feedback.
Admin panel shows basic summary stats (e.g., counts by status) that update when data changes.
All new admin controls are disabled appropriately during in-flight mutations to prevent double-submits.

requirements.text: Perform a focused bugfix/stability pass on admin flow and order management UI to reduce glitches (loading states, error handling, query invalidation, and empty/unauthorized states).

quotes: make sure the site is not buggy

acceptanceCriteria: All admin mutations (status update, tracking save, delete, reset) surface actionable error messages and do not leave the UI in a stuck loading state.
React Query cache invalidation is consistent so lists/details stay in sync after admin actions.
Unauthorized backend calls trap with clear messages and do not expose data.
Admin UI handles empty states and null/undefined values (e.g., trackingNumber) without console errors.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo.
Only generate backend/migration.mo if a stable-state schema change is required; prefer additive/non-breaking changes when possible.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn components); compose them instead.
Do not edit immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.frontend.immutablePaths (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Add third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Add external databases or external backend services.
Add payment processing or checkout flow changes.
